versions.changelog: v2.3 quality enhancement - security audit + marketing packaging + slug-content validation

Initial release of timer-alert-tool-free.

- Provides free background timer functionality: count down in seconds, minutes, and hours.
- Supports 6 time formats, custom notification messages, Pomodoro timer (25+5), and multiple parallel timers.
- Agents receive system notifications and can manage timers (list, poll, view log, terminate).
- Excludes advanced features found in Pro version, such as recurring reminders, template library, and time-based triggers.
- Designed for personal users and indie developers to manage time-based tasks efficiently.
